events.title: The boss got angry...
events.summary: I decided it was about time I got around to implementing special abilties to the 3 boss variants in the game: charger, minion spawning and AoE damage/knockback based on the boss type is now part of the game, including the demo. While I was at it I also improved the graphics on a few different things such as the xp orbs and the bullets Any kind of feedback is much appreciated!

events.title: Gearing up for early access

I truly hope and believe this will make the experience better. This includes much improved sprites, effects and general feel of the game.
